ui_bugs.issue: After selecting a project, the week date-strip in slot-picker opens on a past week (today 2026-10-24, picker defaults to 'Sat 17 – Fri 23 Oct 2026') where every day shows '—' (no slots). User must click the '>' arrow to advance to the current/next week before any slots become selectable. If a user clicks a '—' day and submits they get a 'Pick a slot' error. Expected: default to the current week (containing today) or the first week with availability.

URL param view=list is not honored — page keeps rendering the Kanban board. The source=Brochure filter IS applied correctly (only Brochure-tagged lead cards remain). Low priority: ERP users can toggle view via UI; but programmatic deep-link does not open the table/list view.

rca of the issue: ERP visit-create-dialog default week: likely the week-strip component computes `startOfWeek(today)` using a non-locale-aware or wrong week-start day, producing a 7-day window that ends BEFORE today. On 2026-10-24 (Sat) the strip shows 'Sat 17 – Fri 23 Oct 2026' which is exactly 7 days before. Fix: either (a) use date-fns `startOfWeek(today, { weekStartsOn: 6 })` (Saturday-start) or (b) ensure the strip range is `[today, today+6]` or the first week whose end >= today. If the component already supports a `defaultDate` prop, pass the first date >= today that has at least one open slot (via /api/public/visits/availability lookahead).
